generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025percent of the contact value Min Rs.500 and Max Rs.7500 soon after contract has been issued to bidder

As per Karnataka State Government Order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and G.No. PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted welfare fund
Conditional Tenders will not be accepted

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
Tenderer shall note that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
All materials required for this work, shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before use on the work

All the items includes with all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, Cost of materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal.

The tendered shall scan the original ownership document/ lease / hire commitment Agreement scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid & copies attested by Notary/Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall be submitted for records
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty charges on Construction materials and other taxes as applicable
The Project Completion Period is 31 days and the tenderer should maintain the work during the defect and liability period. Which is 1 year after the successful completion of the work
Proof of Site Visit Certificate from Registrar RCU should be enclosed

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing, installing and commissioning of solar street light at Kitturu Rani Channamma University, New Campus, Hirebagewadi, Belagavi

itemList.description: Supply, Installation, Testing, and commissioning of 20W LED Semi-Integrated Solar Street Lighting System with 6M GI Pole including Excavation of pit of adequate dimensions (approx. 1m x 1m x 1.2m) for pole foundation in all kinds of soil, RCC foundation work (M25 grade & steel barbending & fixing) including casting of foundation block, embedding J-bolts/cage, curing, and backfilling, fixing of GI Pole: 6 Meter (6m) Octagonal / Tubular Hot Dip Galvanized Iron (GI) Pole, thickness min. 2mm, with base plate, anchor bolts, and top bracket for solar panel mounting Heavy-duty galvanized iron / powder-coated structure designed to withstand wind speed up to 150 km/h, with adjustable tilt angle with UV-resistant multi-strand copper flexible DC cables, junction box, cable ties, stainless steel nuts, bolts, and spring washers etc as per requirement; Solar PV Module: Mono/Multi-Crystalline Solar Panel, Capacity: 60W, High efficiency grade A cells with anodized aluminum frame and tempered glass; LED Luminaire / Lamp: High brightness LED light, Power Rating: 20W, High lumen output (greater than 130 lm/W), Working Voltage: DC 12V, CCT: 5700K/6500K, IP65/IP66 protection; Battery Type: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) rechargeable battery pack, Capacity: 18Ah, Voltage: 12.8V, built-in BMS for overcharge/deep-discharge protection; Solar Charge Controller & Control Mode: Built-in MPPT/PWM intelligent charge controller with automatic Dusk-to-Dawn (Auto ON/OFF) sensor and dimming profile complete installation including pole erection, alignment, panel mounting, luminaire fitting, electrical connections & testing as per directions of engineer in charge
